day.headline: A Dragon day — Rat and Monkey are in step.

reasons: Snake sits apart from Dragon — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: an anniversary of nothing in particular
signs.message: Two years since that random Tuesday. Mark it, no justification needed.

reasons: Dragon's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Pat the pocket once, then go. It's where it always is.

reasons: Rat and Dragon share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: You had the salad. Say so when the check lands.

reasons: Rooster pairs with Dragon — a harmonious day
signs.message: One in the morning and you hit send. Stand by it.

reasons: Dog opposes Dragon — a day to take slowly
signs.message: Warm square on the kitchen floor. Take your coffee over there.

reasons: Monkey and Dragon share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Dark by five now. Move dinner earlier, stop fighting it.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Dragon — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the view from the top floor
signs.message: Eight floors up today. Go find a window before you leave.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Dragon — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Eleven songs, no title. Add three tonight, call it finished.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Dragon — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the relative who calls at odd hours
signs.message: Six in the morning, again. Let it ring, call back later.

reasons: Ox sits apart from Dragon — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the album that fits the weather
signs.message: The weather already picked it. Press play, stay horizontal.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Dragon — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the dread before a phone call
signs.message: That call you keep circling. Nothing breaks if it waits.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Dragon — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You quietly changed your mind. No announcement required, not today.
